step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a resilient multi-AZ architecture. Traffic enters through Route 53 to an NLB. The NLB routes incoming traffic to compute workloads spread across two availability zones (represented by dashed boxes), each containing EKS and EC2 instances. From the left compute workload (EC2), requests flow down to an Amazon Aurora database cluster.
